name: Tsubaki Flowers
description: Tsubaki Flowers — a WooCommerce store theme for a florist shop for households and small ceremonies. Cool off-white ground, green-black hairlines, celadon accent. A white intro screen fades away to a full-bleed film-grain photograph with the headline bottom left and a slow parallax drift, then an asymmetric about block, a hairline three-column grid of mixed portrait and landscape photographs, a market band, a week in the shop, people, prices, a ceremony story and a visit block. Hanken Grotesk and Onest. Works without WooCommerce.
